title: 048 - Slug Builder
prompt: Fix the bug so the program build the slug bug-fix-arena from the sample title and prints exactly `bug-fix-arena`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function slugBuilder(int $value): int
{
    if ($value <= 1) {
        return 0;
    }
    return $value * slugBuilder($value - 1);
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function slugBuilder(int $value): int
{
    if ($value <= 1) {
        return 1;
    }
    return $value * slugBuilder($value - 1);
}
hint: Normalize case, trim edges, and replace spaces consistently.
explanation: The broken transformer leaves spaces or uppercase letters behind. Lowercasing, trimming, and joining with hyphens fixes the slug.
